note: THE BOTTLE | It Was So Small. THEME is one little tune at five ages of the devil: Playful (AGE 21, 0:04.4-0:17.9), Wedding (AGE 26, to 0:25.7), Lullaby (AGE 31, to 0:33.5), Swagger (AGE 34, to 0:44.3), Horror (AGE 38, to the dead cut at 0:52.3). RISE, ENDING and SAD are the previous film's (07-the-bottle) files, copied with their .json so the cache hits: same ms and prompt, nothing is made again. pour is the previous film's too; smash, swell and stinger are the shared ones. New effects: hiss, gulp, cork. Everything else is synthesized in mix.py. LULLABY, HEAVY and DREAD (single prompts, 17 Nov) are the recorded beds of AGE 31, AGE 34 and AGE 38; HORROR is the one-shot blast. Third pass (the re-cut, 17 Nov): recorded effects whoosh, zoom, marker, bloop, impact, fizz, clink, deflate, steps, growl; knock is film 07-the-bottle's.

positive_styles: one sour low note at the end

LULLABY.prompt: A slow, tender music-box lullaby in G major, a gentle waltz in 3/4 at 60 BPM, played alone on a small wind-up music box from the very first second: a simple, hummable nursery tune. After three seconds a low, uneasy bowed double-bass drone on G creeps in under it and slowly grows darker to the end. A nursery at night, sweet but unsettling. No drums, no vocals.

HEAVY.prompt: A sinister, swaggering dark waltz in G minor, 3/4 at 120 BPM with slow half-time drums, starting at full strength on the first beat with no intro and no fade-in: low trombones and a tuba play a simple, heavy, strutting tune over a deep kick and a fat snare, low strings underneath, confident and menacing, getting heavier and bigger every bar to the end. Dark cinematic. Instrumental, no vocals.

DREAD.prompt: Full cinematic horror in G minor that starts at full weight on the first beat with no intro and no fade-in: massive low brass playing a slow, crushing waltz in 3/4 at 60 BPM, a dark wordless choir, huge slow drum hits on every bar, screeching high strings, relentless, building louder and louder to the very end without stopping. Terrifying and enormous. Instrumental, no vocals.

HORROR.prompt: Terrifying cinematic horror music in G minor that opens on one colossal impact at full volume: massive deep brass blasts on a low G, a dark wordless choir pad, pounding giant drums and screeching high strings, very slow and huge at 60 BPM, a second, even bigger impact at 6 seconds, then a rising, accelerating build to a wall of sound that stops dead. Instrumental, no vocals.

SAD.prompt: Very quiet, heartbroken solo piano: a few slow, sparse single notes in a minor key at 60 BPM with long silences between them, a soft warm string pad entering halfway, intimate, a father's shame, rain outside. No drums, no vocals.

RISE.prompt: Heroic, emotional comeback training anthem that opens on one huge impact: hard-hitting drums and claps at 128 BPM, a driving bass, soaring strings and bright brass in a major key, a warm piano hook, determined, rising and triumphant, a father earning his daughter's trust back at sunrise. Instrumental, no vocals.

ENDING.prompt: Warm, tender solo piano in a major key at 70 BPM joined by soft swelling strings, gentle, forgiving and full of relief, golden evening light, a child running into her father's arms, rising to one quiet glowing chord. No drums, no vocals.
